overview_description.description: Born To Die Game (BTDG) is a high-quality 3D shooter set in the metaverse. It centers on NFT-based heroes that drive the gameplay. Developed for two years, it's now set for launch. Players can choose free-to-play or play-to-earn modes; the latter lets them earn DIE tokens for minting in-game NFTs. An AI engine adjusts difficulty based on game level, player skill, and weapons. A marketplace allows trading of NFTs, including hero derivatives.
